Fantech Cruize 7.1 HG31 Gaming Headset (7.1 Virtual Surround Sound / 50mm Audio Drivers / RGB Illumination / Omni-Directional Noise-Canceling Mic / Ergonomic Over-Ear Design / USB Audio Connection)

Elevate your competitive audio experience with the Fantech Cruize 7.1 HG31 Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered with 7.1 virtual surround sound and powerful 50mm dynamic audio drivers, the HG31 delivers precise positional audio and immersive soundstage for PC gaming. Features striking RGB lighting effects, an omni-directional noise-canceling microphone for clear voice communication, comfortable over-ear leatherette ear pads, and a durable USB interface designed for long gaming sessions.
